safety_security_measures_007.evidence: For large events security patrols are to be employed by the school. / Access to schools will be limited to: salespeople, vendors, agents, etc. who are directly involved in school fundraisers or other school functions; those individuals listed above must have a vendor letter for the current school year signed by the director of special programs. / Parents who volunteer as chaperones on field trips must go through the Raptor system before going on a field trip.
